usage: agentware checkup [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--status-line]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --status-line         print the one-line SessionStart banner ONLY when a
                        fresh report exists (read-only; byte-identical no-op
                        when OFF/no-report)
